style: Style: a real photograph taken on a phone by a colleague, natural daylight, slightly imperfect framing, slight film grain, warm tone, shallow depth of field. Not polished, not a studio shoot, not a model, no perfect grooming, natural skin texture with pores and small flaws. Keep the person centred with clear space above the head and around the shoulders. No text, no logos, no watermark.

jobs.name: owner-office
jobs.prompt:
Scene: a small, slightly cluttered business office in Perth, Australia; afternoon window light; a laptop, loose paperwork and a half-finished coffee on the desk; a whiteboard with a scribbled job list out of focus behind.
Subject: an Australian man in his mid 40s who runs a small trades business, in a faded navy polo with a worn collar, a few days of stubble, hair not styled.
Details: caught mid-moment glancing up from his phone toward someone off camera, an easy half-smile, relaxed shoulders, one forearm resting on the desk.
Constraints: candid snapshot, not posed; ordinary bloke, not a model; no suit, no tie, nothing corporate; head and shoulders framed with room above.

jobs.name: owner-young
jobs.prompt:
Scene: the front counter of a small Australian business, daylight through a shopfront window, a laptop and a notebook on the counter, product samples and shelving softly out of focus behind.
Subject: an Australian man in his early 30s who owns the business; short neat hair, light stubble; a plain untucked button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled, or a fitted tee under an open overshirt.
Details: leaning on the counter with an open, friendly, slightly curious expression, looking at the camera as if he is about to ask a question; easygoing, approachable, capable.
Constraints: candid and unposed; not rough, not weathered, not corporate; natural skin, no retouching; head and shoulders framed with room above.
